description: The personalised first touches waiting for a human yes — each with the subject and opening Bob wrote for that prospect, and the prospect it is addressed to. This is what a human approves in the dashboard; an agent can read the same rows. (GET /api/v1/outreach/messages; needs the read:outreach scope)

project.description: Project id or slug. Resolved inside the key owner's portfolio; an unowned value matches nothing rather than 404ing.

state.description: Message state; default awaiting_review — the review queue itself.
